description.p: TRAX3D is a free model railway planner you use in 3D. Lay your layout with the manufacturers' track libraries – more than a hundred of them, from Märklin, Fleischmann, Roco, Peco, Kato, Trix, PIKO, Tillig, Atlas, Bachmann, LGB and many more – so what you draw is what you can buy and build.

Shape the landscape around your track: hills, tunnels, bridges, rivers, lakes and canals, roads and walls, grass, trees and buildings. Switch to the CAD drawing to see the measurements, radii and gradients, and let TRAX3D check your layout for grades that are too steep, curves that are too tight and tracks that lie too close together.

Make a parts list of everything you have laid and share your layout with other model railway enthusiasts in the showcase. Your layouts are kept on the server, so you can work on them from any computer. TRAX3D needs an internet connection and an account, which is free. There is no advertising.
